title: Global variables not working properly
body:
### Bug Description

Hello, I've been testing this project and I'm facing an issue with the global variables not working properly.
For the tests I've done, they save and can be retrieved. But they dont work on many components I've tried.

For example, Ollama model when loading the model list

### Reproduction

To reproduce, just need to set this workflow and press reload on the model list of ollama
If you provide the raw value it works and shows the list, but if you set it as a global variable you see this error when trying to load the list

I'm using langlow with the docker-compose option

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/24b2b434-8347-4ba2-8584-0404106b1e00)


### Expected behavior

The global variable should work exactly like when setting the raw value

### Who can help?

_No response_

### Operating System

WSL2 - Ubuntu

### Langflow Version

1.0.18

### Python Version

None

### Screenshot

Here you can see an screenshot of the error logs on the langflow container
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/20935b43-c3e8-4eda-8125-fe25dab79d5c)


### Flow File

_No response_

ai_judgment.response: Yes. The issue involves workflow anomalies and references an LLM provider (Ollama model). The problem with global variables affecting the model list loading suggests a failure in agent-specific components, possibly related to tool invocation or workflow execution.
